manifest.description: Ensure a Forgejo user exists for a bro principal. Finds or creates the user, creates/rotates an API token, stores the token secret, and upserts the ExternalIdentity mapping. Emits bro.identity.provisioned on success.
when_to_use: triggered by bro.identity.required reaction to provision a Forgejo identity
safe to retry: idempotent if the token secret already resolves and verifies

instance.description: Forgejo instance identifier (used in identity key)

bro.description: Bro name from the identity request

display_name.description: Full name for the Forgejo user

token_secret_name.description: Name under which to store the API token secret (via write_file_secret)

admin_token_ref.description: secret:<name> reference to the Forgejo admin token

base_url.description: Forgejo base URL (e.g. http://localhost:3000). Preferred for tests.

base_url_env.description: Env var name holding the Forgejo base URL. Used in production deployments.
